name: No prose/reasoning sentence contradicts the structured prediction
description: No prose/reasoning sentence contradicts the structured prediction.

planSteps.description: On a sampled /match page and the Final page, read the structured prediction (winner/champion) AND the reasoning prose paragraph(s)

Verify no prose sentence names a different winner or champion than the structured prediction (the exact bug to catch: a "champion: France" block beside a line that says "Japan win"). Any contradiction fails.
